question: What differentiates second-generation biofuels as described in the passage?

options.text: They are produced from agricultural residue

solution: The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. They are produced from agricultural residue**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **“produced from agricultural residue”** means that these biofuels are made from the leftover material or waste from agricultural processes, such as crop stalks or husks. (कृषि अपशिष्ट से उत्पादित) • **Example:** Second-generation biofuels are created from rice husks and wheat straw, not from food crops. • Second-generation biofuels are distinct because they do not compete with food resources and utilize materials that would otherwise be discarded. • This makes them cleaner and more sustainable alternatives to fossil fuels. Therefore, the correct answer is- They are produced from agricultural residue [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **They originate from edible crops** (ये खाद्य फसलों से उत्पन्न होते हैं): Refers to first-generation biofuels made from food crops like corn or sugarcane. • **Example:** First-generation biofuels use edible crops, unlike second-generation biofuels. • **They require fossil fuel blending** (इनमें जीवाश्म ईंधन का मिश्रण आवश्यक होता है): Means that these biofuels must be mixed with fossil fuels. • **Example:** Second-generation biofuels can often be used directly or blended, but their main feature is their origin from waste, not blending requirements. • **They emit excessive carbon** (ये अत्यधिक कार्बन उत्सर्जित करते हैं): Means they produce a lot of carbon dioxide. • **Example:** Second-generation biofuels are considered cleaner and emit less carbon compared to fossil fuels. 44:Te6a, The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. It transforms multiple economic sectors**.
